    5
    Best comfy bra

    I'm typically size 32C, and XS fits perfectly. Not too tight, and not too loose. I'm usually a Small in Athleta's bras, so I'd say these run slightly bigger than normal. The bra is soft and well-structured; supportive without being restrictive. Doesn't have bra pads. Which I like, honestly: it doesn...'t flatten me out. I got all 3 colours. If there are more colours, I'll buy those too. There is a tag in the inner side seam, but it was one of those that can be easily ripped out in 30 seconds, scissors are definitely not needed. You only have yourself to blame if you put a hole in your bra.

    VersusVS
